floors.note: what a model reproducing the TRAINING (or validation) winters exactly would score against the test winters; intervals: block bootstrap over test winters

bootstrap_train.note: EVT margins refitted on resampled training winters; dependence models fixed; Gaussian copula: 2e6 draws; VAE: the 3 seeds' 2e6 draws each, pooled

normal_score_noise.note: ratio for a Gaussian copula (exactly normal margins) in 20 independent samples of 100000 fields: pure Monte Carlo noise
